subject: OrbitAI - temporary quota uplift & blended true-up proposal
messages:
From: Max Chen <max.chen@orbitai.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@orbitai.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: short-term quota bump for upcoming demo week

Hi Aditya / Laura,

Quick heads-up — our staging load has spiked while we run integration tests for the PilotWeek demo (Aug 24–27). We expect a 6x token peak for ~36 hours starting Aug 24 noon PDT. Current quota will throttle us and risk demo failures.

Can Redwood provide an ephemeral uplift (temporary rate-limit increase) for that window? We're open to a short-term blended rate or a capped headroom charge; Procurement wants the cost band and PO-ready wording.

Attached is a draft PO for your review (orbitai_po_draft.pdf). If we can get a short-term uplift + clear true-up mechanics (how overrun billing will be handled), we can finalize the PO and confirm.

Thanks,
Max
Max Chen
Head of Platform
OrbitAI

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Max Chen <max.chen@orbitai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term quota bump for upcoming demo week

Thanks for the note, Max — and great heads-up on timing. Important details for sizing the uplift: anticipated sustained QPS and expected median sequence length during the peak. Can you share an estimate (ballpark is fine) so we can model throughput and propose the right capacity profile?

High-level options we can offer for a 36-hour window:
- Ephemeral headroom: +6x quota on current plan, capped tokens, flat uplift fee (predictable)
- Burst band w/ blended overrun: allow bursts beyond quota with a blended per-token rate for the window and true-up on monthly invoice
- Reserved short-term slot: standby capacity reserved for that window (higher fixed fee but no overrun billing)

I'll loop in Jordan to prepare a quick blended-quote matrix and draft language that Procurement can drop into the PO. If you confirm the peak estimate by EOD tomorrow we can get approval from Billing and legal for the wording.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Max Chen <max.chen@orbitai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term quota bump for upcoming demo week

Max — thanks, pulled together the modelling based on a 6x peak assumption and two sequence-length scenarios. Summary below; full spreadsheet attached as redwood_aug2026_blended_quote.pdf.

Scenario A (short sequences, ~40 tokens median):
- Allow +6x ephemeral headroom for 36 hours
- Cap at 1.2M tokens for the window
- Blended per-token rate during window: $0.0009/token (includes 20% demo window surcharge)
- True-up: any usage beyond the cap is billed at standard overrun rate ($0.0016/token) on the next invoice.

Scenario B (long sequences, ~260 tokens median):
- Allow +4x (we recommend smaller multiplier for longer seqs)
- Cap at 900k tokens for the window
- Blended per-token rate: $0.00125/token
- True-up beyond cap billed at $0.0019/token

Contract language we recommend for PO: short-term uplift is granted for specified window, usage within the capped volume will be billed at the agreed blended rate; usage beyond cap converts to overrun charges and will appear as a separate line item on next invoice; Redwood will provide usage report within 48 hours post-window.

We can accept the PO if you add a single line referencing the agreed cap and blended rate. If Procurement needs a firm SOW or legal language, Laura can provide the PO-ready clause.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Renewals & Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Max Chen <max.chen@orbitai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@orbitai.com>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@orbitai.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term quota bump for upcoming demo week

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear options. We ran internal checks and confirmed Scenario A (short sequences) is the right fit. We'll accept: +6x ephemeral headroom, 1.2M token cap, blended rate $0.0009/token, true-up at $0.0016/token beyond cap. Please confirm the following before we route the PO:

1) Redwood will provide a usage CSV and short reconciliation report within 48 hours after Aug 27 close.
2) Billing will place the blended charge as a single line item on the Aug invoice; any overrun will be separate and flagged.
3) We need a short clause for the PO that reads: "Redwood Inference will provide a temporary quota uplift for Aug 24 12:00 PDT through Aug 26 23:59 PDT with usage capped at 1.2M tokens billed at the agreed blended rate. Any usage beyond the cap will be invoiced at the overrun rate. Redwood will deliver a post-window usage report within 48 hours."

If you can reply with a one-line confirmation and the final quote PDF we will sign and send PO this afternoon.

Thanks,
Max
